items.text: Opioids are ravaging Native American communities, but only 1 in 8 individuals struggling with substance use disorder are able to get treatment. The U.S. government needs to keep our word to tribal nations and actually provide the health care we've repeatedly promised to deliver. https://t.co/lBZli6Tx9p

Firefighters shouldn't have to rely on crowdfunding sites to cover treatment for illnesses or injuries caused by their job. I'm glad the Administration is taking this step, but I will continue pushing for our bipartisan bill to boost pay and benefits.

https://t.co/dIfJdqZ3Ip

Last year, Fisher-Price leadership was called before Congress to account for over 100 infant deaths in the recalled Rock N Play. We asked Mattel GM Chuck Scothon whether he knew of any other deaths in products still on the market. He lied under oath. https://t.co/8niZJ8grT7

David Lin, an American citizen and constituent of mine, has been wrongfully detained in China for ~16 years. @SenSherrodBrown and I are leading a bicameral, bipartisan letter urging @POTUS to redouble efforts to bring David home, especially given his daughter's cancer diagnosis. https://t.co/v2PKc1fIh7

Today, I tested positive for COVID-19. I was exposed at work here in CA. I’ll vote proxy this week rather than travel to D.C. I have the usual symptoms, especially a sore throat, so I’m communicating via text—and whiteboard. https://t.co/ljgQFXdLo9

Patients are 3x to 6x more likely to be forced out of network for mental health treatment. My new bill with @SenWarren and @RepCardenas increases oversight of insurance companies that fail to cover mental health and empowers consumers to report violations.

My heart is with every Californian hit hard by the latest storms, and I'm so thankful for the first responders who keep our communities safe. As we prepare for more extreme weather, please exercise caution and sign up for local alerts: https://t.co/S26HnyaC3l

Delivery drivers like UPS @Teamsters are the backbone of our nation’s economy. I'm hopeful they reach a fair contract with good wages and safe working conditions.

In Congress, I’m fighting to protect workers’ rights and hold corporations accountable for unfair treatment.

I had a great conversation last week with @USDOL Assistant Secretary Lisa M. Gomez and advocates about strengthening mental health coverage—including two of my bills that were signed into law! We've got more work to do for every American to get the care they need. https://t.co/4XQo7tGTTG

Consumers sued J&J alleging that its baby powder caused cancer. J&J then split its company into two halves to skirt accountability. And, it argued that this finance scheme should be secret—but patients should have to make disclosures to get justice.

I called out this hypocrisy. https://t.co/0vePXhkJeZ

Job-related stress pushes teachers out of classrooms and leaves kids without adequate support. My Teacher Health and Wellness Act would help address educators’ mental health and improve retention. #WorldTeachersDay

Too many Americans can't get mental health care. Four of my proposals to address this crisis are now law:
☑️Enforcing mental health parity
☑️Delivering coverage to public servants
☑️Creating a maternal mental health hotline
☑️Funding the Veterans Crisis Line
#WorldMentalHealthDay

I’ve consistently called out Big Insurance for how it often skirts the law requiring mental health to be covered the same as physical health. This settlement is a win for patients and workers, and a testament to how unions like @NUHW are powerful partners in oversight.

Getting a COVID vaccine should be just like getting a flu shot, but some insurers are delaying or denying payment—leaving families unprotected during a surge in cases. I wrote to the country's largest health insurance CEOs to get us answers. https://t.co/ndNEoSWqEZ

Big Pharma is suing to keep Medicare from negotiating drug costs.

But two companies, @Merck and @bmsnews, raked in a collective $7 BILLION in profits in just the past three months.

When Big Pharma says we can’t lower prices, it’s the greed talking.

Kudos to @CMSgov for hosting patient listening sessions on each drug up for Medicare negotiation. Cracking down on Big Pharma’s greed only happens when policymakers lift up the voices of patients—instead of doing the bidding of special interests.

In the past decade, Californians' home insurance rates have nearly doubled. As climate change worsens natural disasters, insurance companies and elected officials must work to protect families' homes and wallets. Proud to partner across the aisle with @RepLaMalfa on this. https://t.co/NLCceadHNv

Health insurance companies are corrupting Medicare and stealing taxpayers' money—to the tune of $75 billion just this year. @RepLloydDoggett and I led 17 of our colleagues in a letter urging @CMSgov to crack down on two of the ways greedy insurers defraud Medicare. https://t.co/18CS9IdExA

Medical debt does nothing but harm Americans, especially when collectors don’t follow the law. My Medical Debt Relief Act would keep costs from medical treatment off credit reports, protecting the financial futures of millions of Americans.

Many Americans aren’t aware that deferring Medicare coverage can result in higher health care costs for their rest of their lives. I just reintroduced my common-sense Medicare Economic Security Solutions Act with @RepYoungKim to cap late enrollment fees for seniors.

Attention Older Americans 📢

Tomorrow, I’m hosting a telephone town hall to discuss how I'm working to strengthen Medicare, Social Security, and other policies that will help our nation’s seniors. Dial in at 10:30am PT 👇 https://t.co/CeDkKASLLA

California is experiencing an insurance crisis—families are facing higher rates, difficulty finding insurers, and climate change risks. @RepLaMalfa and I convened a briefing with major insurance companies to talk about protecting families and bringing stability to the market. https://t.co/UTscipL7ku

The infant formula crisis devastated our supply chain and hurt families. This year, I teamed up with @RepLisaMcClain to hold corporations and @US_FDA accountable. Our bill would add new safeguards to keep contaminated formula out of grocery stores. (3/9) https://t.co/v2POnZoxU8

Don’t let the name fool you: Medicare Advantage's biggest "advantage" is for big health insurers that line their pockets at our expense.

@WendellPotter and I sat down to discuss what health care options older Americans have, and why we're fighting to grow Traditional Medicare. https://t.co/Rq4PA8LgRi
Watch our entire conversation on Traditional Medicare and Medicare Advantage to see how greedy health insurers are scamming taxpayers and putting patients at risk.👇 https://t.co/Hvr2MDB82J
